items.title: Chainflip’s losses climb to $12 million after protocol discloses 122.9 BTC theft, offers hacker bounty
items.summary: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return the remainder of the $12 million in stolen BTC, ETH, and stablecoins by Monday.
